note: Each requirement a test proves, registered before its test exists. A row holds its id (<owner's last segment>.<words>), one description sentence, the owner package, its layer (unit, integration, contract, e2e or native; a layer's limit is test-sizes.json's for its size) and its seconds budget; a test names the ids it proves with @pytest.mark.proves. Holders, lifecycle (proposed, active, quarantined, retired) and the commit that added a row are derived, never stored. An id is never reused: a retired row stays. Find before writing one: python scripts/tests_registry.py find "<words>".

alpha_research.sealed_selection_survives.description: If members added later could move a sealed inner selection, an Alpha study's recorded choice would stop matching the evidence it came from.

alpha_research.verification_hash_covers_.description: If an executed scoring or outcome module sat outside the verified hash, changed code would keep an old identity and pass as already verified.

alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_bi.description: If the Evidence runtime's identity left out an owner of selection or a capability, reviews could reuse retrieval from a different runtime.

alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_re.description: If a workspace installed an Evidence runtime whose semantic capability differs, its reviews would run on a model its identity never named.

architecture.discovered_imports_kept_by_.description: A module's discovered imports are kept in the process by its place under the source root and its bytes, so changed bytes or another place miss and a read or parse error is raised every time.

architecture.every_src_module_imports_of.description: Every src module imports with the network disabled, and each pydantic contract's frozen and extra settings at runtime match those read from source by the static contract test.

architecture.impact_graph_selection.description: The verification selector finds real consumer and deleted-source tests and dispatches them without repeating structural checks.

architecture.import_law_refuses_higher_l.description: The import law built from the package registry refuses a package importing a higher level or an undeclared peer, and any file importing a retired owner, direct or relative; an import downward or of a lookalike name passes.

architecture.repository_root_is_its_trac.description: The repository root is judged by the files git tracks at HEAD: its required public files, nothing unexpected, and never a checkout's ignored or untracked local files.

architecture.scan_facts_kept_by_bytes_un.description: A scan's kept per-file fact is served only for the bytes it came from under a valid seal and shape, and its store stays bounded and rebuildable.

composition.keyed_analyst_submissions_ke.description: Concurrent keyed Analyst submissions receive definite outcomes, filed outcomes replay exactly, and refusals that filed nothing are retryable.

composition.observation_writes_do_not_wa.description: A held workspace mutation does not prevent the independent observation owner from recording request entry and a counted refusal.

composition.sealed_review_update_verifie.description: Concurrent readers of one sealed review update share one verification, each with its own copy, and a failed verification is never kept.

composition.session_observation_attribut.description: A named sandbox-bound Session keeps its request attribution while an anonymous request remains unassigned and Activity names that attribution unknown.

composition.workspace_binding_usage_unkn.description: An unreadable workspace-owned Session binding makes usage unavailable without hiding other readable Session results or treating the binding as absent.

data_platform.session_authority_is_conte.description: The Host resolves one trading calendar: weekends are covered but are not sessions, and one range always seals the same axis while a narrower range seals another.

evaluation.continuation_snapshot_integri.description: A native acceptance continuation admits only the exact tracked bytes written by its recorded prestart configure and refuses other tracked changes.

evaluation.golden_consumers_queue_behind.description: Under a parallel run, a session golden's first consumer keeps its place and builds it, and its other consumers are queued where the recorded work ahead passes that build, or last when it is unrecorded, never blocked on its lock.

evaluation.listener_boundary_samples_sur.description: A replay monitor samples the local Host at both declared ACK markers before acknowledging them, including when work ends before the next periodic sample.

exception.why: A real Host exercises the sampled ACK markers
exception.decided: 2026-10-29: approved; real Host sampling exercises the ACK markers

evaluation.live_read_watches_every_task.description: A native run's live read keeps every Task it has seen current past the Host's per-page watch cap, so a leg sees its goal end.

evaluation.native_hosts_stop_with_their_.description: A native acceptance run stops its own recorded workspace Hosts and proves each listener and process ended, or names the unproved stop.

evaluation.native_leg_stops_by_name.description: One command starts, resumes and collects a native leg of either host, and every stop carries a named reason and its evidence.

evaluation.persistent_golden_root_follow.description: The persistent golden cache root is the operator's shared setting when present and the checkout's own folder when absent.

evaluation.sessionless_first_use_questio.description: A sessionless first-use question is attributed only when its authenticated Host record matches the sole verified workspace and goal identity.

factor_research.curation_and_handoff_are.description: If Factor curation or Alpha handoff trained a model or depended on its actor, a recorded decision would not reopen safely.

feature_engine.closure_history_folds_its.description: If the closure ledger rebuilt a history from anything but its map and revisions, a Feature panel would mix sector facts from another time.

feature_engine.closure_ledger_survives_a.description: If the closure ledger lost its place across a failed store write or misread its revisions, Feature panels would rebuild wrongly or recompute published work.

feature_engine.closure_store_takes_only_.description: If the coordinator handed the store identities it never derived, a Feature store could hold its data under another closure's name.

feature_engine.current_pointer_swaps_fai.description: If the current panel pointer moved without its compare and swap, two writers could leave readers on a publication neither finished.

feature_engine.factor_handoff_refuses_a_.description: If a Factor handoff accepted a corrupt copy, a changed source or a tampered pool, Alpha research would train on inputs its binding never named.

feature_engine.handoff_binds_logical_clo.description: If an Alpha handoff changed its original Factor inputs or failed to bind the logical panel closure, a later reader could use a different dataset.

feature_engine.logical_identity_moves_on.description: If logical identity followed encoding, write batches or policy instead of content, reuse would serve changed values or rebuild unchanged panels.

feature_engine.panel_chunks_stay_bound_t.description: If a panel chunk's bytes or hash drifted from the binding that wrote it, a reader would accept data under an identity it never had.

feature_engine.source_prefix_proof_tells.description: If materialization identity blurred null, NaN, signed zero or absent rows, or kept a sealed year after a write, stale Feature stores would pass as current.

local_application.configure_offers_a_wor.description: A sandboxed configure offers the default new workspace when none exists and a coded choice when existing workspaces need selection.

local_application.configure_offers_missi.description: Sandboxed configure offers each missing setup prerequisite in order before its serve command.

local_application.first_use_offers_deleg.description: A first-use plan offers its delegated network action immediately without waiting for the separate coded daily-consent answer.

local_application.native_tool_setup_uses.description: The offered locked tool setup runs its existing steps with checkout-owned Windows scratch and removes the scratch on success or failure.

local_application.node_invocation_preser.description: Node test invocation preserves availability and caller environment while resolving absolute browser directory aliases to their physical targets.

local_application.playwright_setup_refus.description: Playwright setup refuses linked or unverifiable installation paths before mutating them while preserving independently owned physical installations.

local_application.retrieval_setup_uses_w.description: Retrieval setup gives its Windows subprocesses a temporary directory inside the writable checkout and removes it after use.

market_data_ops.daily_provider_conforman.description: Every daily market-data provider, the yfinance adapter and each shared fake, answers bars, actions and adjusted closes in the port's shape: exactly the requested symbols, every field finite, inside the window, ascending and split-sound.

market_data_ops.hydration_provider_confo.description: Every one-response history provider returns the daily port's own rows with in-window actions, adjusted closes and repaired sessions that name only those rows.

market_data_ops.sector_provider_conforma.description: Every current-sector provider names itself and the symbol asked, gives a stripped sector and a 64-hex payload hash, answers alike twice, and refuses an unknown symbol with a typed provider failure.

observation_runtime.accepted_answers_ent.description: If one accepted role answer published twice or lost its submitting lead, the ledger would count work that was never one exchange.

observation_runtime.ledger_has_one_sqlit.description: If two writers shared the store or a reader blocked the writer, ledger rows could interleave or the Host would stall recording.

observation_runtime.ledger_reads_answer_.description: If a bounded or correlated read followed a wrong run or hid a tampered row, callers would credit evidence the ledger does not hold.

observation_runtime.ledger_records_each_.description: If a repeated, corrected or failed append changed the observation ledger, its record of what happened could no longer be replayed or trusted.

observation_runtime.ledger_refuses_what_.description: If secrets, private cognition or unbacked decisions reached an append, the ledger would keep them durably or claim authority nobody gave.

observation_runtime.ledger_stays_inside_.description: If retention ignored the workspace cap or compacted protected rows partially, the ledger would fill the disk or silently lose records it promised to keep.

observation_runtime.process_is_held_to_h.description: A runner binds its process to at most half the machine's logical processors, or to the narrower allowance it already inherited, and reads the bound back from the operating system.

observation_runtime.usage_recording_expo.description: If a usage callback's failure or free text reached owner health, recording could break or private native paths and prose could leak to readers.

pipeline.a_boundary_import_is_refused_at.description: If the merge gate missed a changed import across the release boundary, a public file would ship depending on private code.

pipeline.code_health_reports_every_row.description: The daily code-health report reads sizes, boundaries, growers, dead code, dependencies and complexity from the tree, reuses an unchanged tree's rows, and reads a failed row as unmeasured, never zero.

pipeline.cost_receipt_contains_required_.description: A cost commit stage runs required named test families, including Large, and records their bounded outcomes without changing ordinary selection.

pipeline.definition_refuses_malformed_ro.description: A malformed pipeline definition is refused on load by code, naming its stage or row, and the shipped definition loads.

pipeline.development_labels_cannot_grow_.description: If the development-label allowance could grow or reset, internal card and line names would leak into public files with nothing refusing them.

pipeline.flake_quarantine_candidates.description: The test-health owner derives quarantine candidates from distinct verified flake observations, registered owners and review dates.

pipeline.health_report_counts_the_test_m.description: The daily test-health report counts test and source lines, registered and multiply held requirements, large files, quarantines, stage verdicts, flakes and slow tests, ranks each test's seconds from healthy runs only, and leaves a rate unknown without receipts.

pipeline.public_closure_needs_every_file.description: If a public file could import, link, run or read a private file, the published checkout would break for its users or point at private work.

pipeline.public_durations_come_from_juni.description: The public tests' durations file comes from JUnit records: the latest run of each node wins, skipped and out-of-tree nodes are left out, and an unreadable record refuses by name.

pipeline.public_manifest_settles_every_f.description: If the manifest guessed, skipped a file or let a public consumer pull private tools out, private work would escape in the next export.

pipeline.public_outputs_need_a_declared_.description: If a generated output counted as public without its declaration, write and proved sources, a private path or stale file could ship in the export.

pipeline.public_review_never_copies_a_di.description: If the manifest copied a disclosure's text or kept a review after its line changed, a secret could enter Git or an unreviewed edit could ship.

pipeline.public_snapshot_holds_only_prov.description: If the snapshot took a blob the manifest does not prove or added private history, the export would publish bytes nobody reviewed.

pipeline.public_worker_timeout_diagnosti.description: A public worker crash prints its matching active timeout event while a crash without a timeout stays distinct.

pipeline.receipt_classes_every_red.description: Each red node and non-passing stage row classes as a defect, flake, slow test, load or tooling from its own evidence, and a red with no evidence reads unclassified, never a defect.

pipeline.receipt_plugin_writes_each_node.description: The receipt plugin writes each test node once, after its last phase or a crash, with its failure's masked signature, and then disposes of itself.

pipeline.receipt_verifies_only_complete_.description: A stage receipt verifies only when every announced event arrived and it meets the requested stage, host, head, result and optional passing test and time-limit checks.

pipeline.result_cache_hits_only_on_uncha.description: A result-cache entry hits only while every file, listing, probe and variable value its group read is unchanged, and its declared key is the same.
pipeline.result_cache_hits_only_on_uncha.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_never_trusts_a_bad.description: A result-cache entry that is damaged, of another schema or key, or names a path outside its checkout is a miss, and a store or tree that cannot be used turns the cache off by its reason.
pipeline.result_cache_never_trusts_a_bad.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_refuses_undeclared.description: A recorder observes collection and execution inputs, storing only complete first-attempt passing results and declining opaque readers or bound native predicates without changing test outcomes.
pipeline.result_cache_refuses_undeclared.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_runner_serves_veri.description: The runner reuses only verified passing groups, records cache provenance, and runs misses or shadow comparisons without hiding changed or opaque inputs.
pipeline.result_cache_runner_serves_veri.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_store_stays_within.description: The result-cache store drops entries idle past 14 days and then the oldest while it holds more bytes than its cap.
pipeline.result_cache_store_stays_within.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.shipped_instruction_links_reach.description: If a shipped instruction linked outside the checkout, an installed agent would follow a dead path during its first use.

pipeline.stage_runs_each_row_by_one_prov.description: A stage run resolves each row on its host to exactly one provider, refusing a row with none or two, and writes a receipt that verifies.

pipeline.stage_target_is_separate_from_s.description: A stage enforces its declared stop while recording wall time, the reported rows and any unexplained time from which its target breach and timing gap can be derived.

pipeline.the_whole_public_tree_closes_at.description: If the release tree stopped closing over its manifest, the export would publish a file whose dependency users cannot get, with the gate silent.

portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_ledg.description: If finalization repeated a step, closed a permit twice or released another package's receipt, a protected result could publish without its own ledger.

portfolio_strategy_lab.ledger_index_tell.description: If a persisted ledger index could not tell a lost child from a bad index, recovery would rerun tampered work or refuse honest loss.

portfolio_strategy_lab.listing_axis_orde.description: If reordered listings hashed the same, two different portfolio paths would share one identity and advancement could reuse the wrong one.

shared_kernel.schema_hash_ignores_prose_.description: If a schema hash followed docstrings or missed a structural change, a rewording would rotate every identity or a real change would keep one.

task_control.a_lost_ledger_rebuilds_only.description: If recovery rebuilt the Task ledger from anything but frozen requests and orphan facts, a writer could invent, drop or repeat admitted Tasks.

testing.codspeed_marks_every_selected_te.description: Under CodSpeed, which deselects unmarked tests, every selected test is marked as a benchmark so the public cost job measures each one; a run without CodSpeed marks none.

testing.crash_requeue_keeps_longest_firs.description: Under load distribution, a crashed worker's prefetched cases return to their place in the longest-first collection order, never after every other case.

testing.find_matches_requirements_and_un.description: One search returns the registered requirements and the unregistered tests whose words match, best first, with each requirement's lifecycle and holders.

testing.layer_contract.description: Registered unit layers obey resource and own-phase time boundaries, while integration layers retain their declared database and file access.

testing.observed_test_resources.description: Each completed test records its own phase durations and observed resources, including subprocess counts and explicit unknowns, without changing its result.

testing.one_holder_per_layer.description: A requirement has one holder file in each layer, while focused functions and parameter cases in that file preserve its place.

testing.only_a_requirement_marker_may_jo.description: If a requirement marker counted as file growth or a test change, tracing a critical test would be refused or push a Large test off its merge path.

testing.reuse_pin_fast_check.description: The fast lane runs the reviewed reuse frontier check on changed pinned source files and names how to refresh a moved pin.

testing.row_admitted_or_refused_by_its_c.description: A new or edited requirement row is admitted at once when its id, owner, sentence, layer and budget pass without a near-duplicate, and is otherwise refused by its failing check or held for the test manager's decision.

testing.session_footprint.description: A verified full pytest run records session-fixture build time and attributed scratch with a sampled basetemp high-water mark and explicit gaps.

testing.unplaced_workers_warn_by_name.description: Inside the private workshop, an unplaced pytest run asking for more than two workers is warned once with heavy_slot's command, never refused; other runs stay silent.

testing.unregistered_test_refused_with_i.description: A new test that proves no registered requirement is refused by the fast guard with what tests find returns for its words and the next lawful step, and in a gate lane beyond its file's legacy count.

testing.whole_file_relocation_restores_b.description: Whole-file test relocation restores bytes and registered references, preserves consumed fixture scope and refuses path, export and fixture-name clashes.

testing.windows_worker_without_wmi.description: A Windows pytest worker obtains platform information without issuing a WMI query.

workspace_runtime.background_task_gate_w.description: A background Task waits for a workspace mutation holder, names the holder and preserves its deferred cancellation without duplicating execution.

workspace_runtime.source_lease_failure_e.description: A failed sealed-source mutation check names the written and observed bytes, restored and observed metadata, and the unavailable lease event.
